question: How many port calls will IMF PortWatch record at Ukraine's three main Black Sea ports over the latest reported week as of October 1, 2026?

calls.reasoning: I pulled the resolution source itself. The HDX CSV (verified identical in row count and end-date to PortWatch's Daily_Ports_Data ArcGIS layer, 44,976 UKR rows through 2026-09-11) shows portcalls = 0 for Odessa (port843), Chornomorsk (port489) and Pivdennyi (port1419) on every dated row from 2026-08-03 through 2026-09-11, and only 9 combined calls in all of 2026 (last one 2026-07-24). The series level-shifted in Oct 2024 (2024-09: 205, 2024-10: 71, 2024-11: 1) and has read ~0 ever since, while real traffic was heavy through mid-2026 - so these zeros are a detection artifact (AIS jamming/spoofing in the Odesa approaches; Danube ports like Reni still register calls), not a reflection of traffic. Either way the instrument prints 0. The 2026 escalation (traffic near standstill since 22 Jul 2026, ~90% YoY drop per Lloyd's List) removes the residual real-traffic path too. Nonzero requires a sporadic single detection (~4 occurred in July 2026) or a PortWatch coverage repair landing in the 29/30 Sep update - I price those at roughly 8% and 2%. No prediction market prices this. P(exactly 0) ~ 0.89.

disagreements.claim: The post-Nov-2024 zeros are a detection artifact rather than a traffic signal
disagreements.verdict: Strongly supported and undisputed - Ukraine exported at scale in 2025 while these ports read ~1/month, and Reni/Izmail/Kerch kept registering calls. No PortWatch changelog acknowledging or repairing it was found by any run

Resolved toward the higher end - Run 2 used the unconditional regime rate without discounting the 49-day zero streak or the post-22-July escalation; my own check that the trade expects Greater Odesa shut into winter further removes the real-traffic path. Settled at 0.87

disagreements.claim: A Black Sea maritime moratorium could restore calls inside the window
disagreements.verdict: REFUTED for this window - no arrangement in force as of 2026-09-21, Russia rejected the mutual-halt offer on 14 Aug, and reporting on 21 Sep has Turkish bodies still only proposing a summit

Took 1.0 - the empirical max of any 7-day window in this regime is 2, so a 1.8 width overstates plausible spread; stated explicitly that the true empirical 10-90 width is 0 and the declared figure is continuity spread

disagreements.claim: A human prediction market prices this quantity
disagreements.verdict: None found - checked Kalshi's Ukraine tag plus general web; Polymarket ceasefire contracts exclude Black-Sea-only deals and do not match resolution source or threshold
